data.why: the repo ships bundled Western blot test images in its root that the app's file_uploader can accept directly

goals: upload a Western blot image and have the app auto-detect band positions without specifying lane count
inspect the horizontal intensity profile to confirm bands were located correctly
quantify relative band intensity (volume and % relative to the strongest band) across lanes
distinguish strong vs weak bands in a blot to assess expression differences
tune detection sensitivity (merge threshold) when bands are over- or under-segmented
export the quantified lane data as a CSV for downstream statistics

review.summary: The tree matches the README's purpose exactly: automatic band detection with no lane count, profile check, relative Volume/% and CSV export. Its stages, labels and the screens I checked are faithful to the app. It needs small fixes before filing: demote the help phase, replace one ambiguous fullscreen screenshot, and say that the strong/weak class is a fixed cutoff and that the README's parameters are missing from the app.
